description: Source-alignment record between the Claude skills in this repo and the Codex plugin port in email-love/codex-agents. Its job is to stop a fix from landing in one surface and silently never reaching the other. Update it whenever either surface ships a change that the other should mirror, and stamp lastAlignmentReview when you have checked the two are in sync.

codexPlugin.note: v3.0.0 repackaged the flat AGENTS.md workflows as a progressively loaded plugin with two skills. Its content was ported from the Claude skills as of the commit above.

drift.summary: Model-choice guidance added to all three skills: strongest available model for Path B / migration-audit / eds-converter (one-time, high rule-count work), a faster model for routine Path A campaign builds.
drift.codexStatus: Not yet ported. Codex has no equivalent note. When porting, keep it model-agnostic ("your strongest available model/effort setting", not Claude model names), since Codex users choose from a different model set.

drift.summary: Stop-and-resume rules (never stop silently, do not pause mid-batch, name the state file) and the builder wrong-file guard.
drift.codexStatus: Content-equivalent already present in the Codex repo via its own edit before v3.0.0 packaging. No port owed; the provenance pin above is simply one commit stale on paper.

drift.summary: Release download fix (all bundles on every release), patch version bumps, and the per-skill update check reading marketplace.json.
drift.codexStatus: Claude-repo-specific. This is GitHub release and marketplace plumbing for the Claude skills and has no equivalent in the Codex plugin.

renderSpecIsCanonical: The render rules (structure.md and references/render-spec.md here) are the single source of truth. The Codex plugin carries mirrored copies. When a render rule changes, change it here first, then regenerate the Codex references rather than hand-editing them, so the two cannot disagree.
